findings.title: Light-theme color changed from 30% to 70% for embedded post author links
findings.body:
The original rule was `scale-color($primary, $lightness: 30%)`. It was rewritten as `dark-light-choose(scale-color($primary, $lightness: 70%), scale-color($secondary, $lightness: 30%))`.

The first argument of `dark-light-choose` is the light-theme value, so this is no longer a dark-theme-only change. On every default (light) site, the bold username links in `.embedded-posts .topic-meta-data h5 a` now become much lighter and lower-contrast.

Every other conversion in this PR keeps the light value and uses the complement for the dark value. This one should be `dark-light-choose(scale-color($primary, $lightness: 30%), scale-color($secondary, $lightness: 70%))`.

findings.title: Light-theme color of group member name changed from 30% to 50%
findings.body:
`.user-stream .group-member-info .name` was `scale-color($primary, $lightness: 30%)`. It is now `dark-light-choose(scale-color($primary, $lightness: 50%), scale-color($secondary, $lightness: 50%))`.

That changes the light-theme rendering: names become lighter and visually identical to `.title`, which is also 50%. This looks like a copy-paste of the `.title` rule.

It should be `dark-light-choose(scale-color($primary, $lightness: 30%), scale-color($secondary, $lightness: 70%))` so light themes are unchanged.

findings.title: Light-theme color of mobile group member name changed from 30% to 50%
findings.body:
This has the same copy-paste error as the desktop file. The original `scale-color($primary, $lightness: 30%)` for `.group-member-info .name` became `dark-light-choose(scale-color($primary, $lightness: 50%), scale-color($secondary, $lightness: 50%))`.

On mobile light themes, member names now render lighter and the same as titles.

It should be `dark-light-choose(scale-color($primary, $lightness: 30%), scale-color($secondary, $lightness: 70%))`.

findings.title: Light and dark arguments swapped for .custom-message-length
findings.body:
The original was `scale-color($primary, $lightness: 70%)`, a faint hint text. The new rule is `dark-light-choose(scale-color($primary, $lightness: 30%), scale-color($secondary, $lightness: 70%))`.

The percentages are inverted, so in light themes the character counter becomes much darker than before.

In dark themes, `$secondary` scaled 70% toward white gives a bright color instead of a dimmed one. The desktop counterpart correctly uses 70%/30%.

It should be `dark-light-choose(scale-color($primary, $lightness: 70%), scale-color($secondary, $lightness: 30%))`.

findings.title: Light-theme color of mobile topic-map h3 changed from 20% to 50%
findings.body:
`.topic-map h3` was `scale-color($primary, $lightness: 20%)`. It is now `dark-light-choose(scale-color($primary, $lightness: 50%), scale-color($secondary, $lightness: 50%))`.

This lightens the topic map headings on mobile light themes, which is unrelated to the dark-theme fix. It also diverges from the desktop rule, which correctly uses 20%/80%.

It should be `dark-light-choose(scale-color($primary, $lightness: 20%), scale-color($secondary, $lightness: 80%))`.
